top_concerns: Headline gains use an oracle gold schema covering the attributes of all evaluation queries; the deployable InferredSchema loses on FB-Agg (0.234 vs 0.598/0.593) and is marginal on Hotels (+0.045)
New datasets are generated from schema records that S-RAG inverts, are small (193/88 questions), and are unvalidated; WorldCup is largely known to LLMs (Table 2)
Weak or narrow baselines: truncated o3 'long context', fixed K=40, no extract-then-query (Arora et al.) baseline, GPT-4o judge without human validation
Single runs with no variance or CIs; Table 4 generality claim rests on +0.025 with the gold schema
Incremental novelty and missing implementation details (record/text-to-SQL models, prompts, cost)

(2) ICLR venue label '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10}' for internal Overall 3 reads confusingly next to 'Borderline Reject (3)'. (3) The ledger/search budget counts queries that failed on network errors. (4) Paper-type choice (empirical vs dataset vs system) is ambiguous for a method+datasets paper; I chose empirical. (5) Five reviewer passes shared one context, so independence is limited.
